hero.title: The Story Behind the Brand
hero.description: Brendia Pro® was born from a passion for excellence and a desire to share the art of weft extensions with stylists worldwide. What started as one woman's journey has become a global movement of empowered professionals.

founder.name: Nikolina Kljaić
bio: With over a decade of experience in the hair extension industry, Nikolina has dedicated her career to perfecting the art of weft extensions and sharing her expertise with others.

Her journey began in a small salon, where her natural talent and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set her apart. Clients traveled from across the country to experience her transformative work, and fellow stylists began asking to learn her techniques.

"I realized that my impact could go far beyond my own chair," Nikolina shares. "By teaching others, I could help hundreds of stylists build successful careers while giving thousands of women the confidence that comes with beautiful hair."

Today, Nikolina leads Brendia Pro® with the same passion and attention to detail that defined her work from day one. Every course, every lesson, every interaction reflects her commitment to excellence and genuine care for her students' success.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Find answers to common questions about our courses, certification process, and what to expect on your journey with Brendia Pro®.

faqs.question: What experience level do I need to enroll?
faqs.answer: Brendia Pro® Artist is designed for stylists at any level, including those new to extensions. We recommend having basic hairstyling skills, but no prior extension experience is required. Advanced Brendia Pro® Artist is ideal for those who have completed the Artist course or have equivalent experience.

faqs.question: How long does it take to complete a course?
faqs.answer: Both courses are self-paced, so you can learn on your own schedule. On average, students complete Brendia Pro® Artist in 6-8 weeks and Advanced Brendia Pro® Artist in 8-12 weeks. However, you have lifetime access, so you can take as long as you need.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Artist and Advanced Artist?
faqs.answer: Brendia Pro® Artist covers all essential techniques for professional weft extension services. Advanced Brendia Pro® Artist includes everything in Artist plus advanced techniques, complex color work, corrective procedures, business strategies, and a personal mentorship session with Nikolina.

faqs.question: Do I need to purchase any additional materials?
faqs.answer: The courses include all digital materials needed to learn. For hands-on practice, you'll need to source your own hair extensions, tools, and a mannequin head. We provide a recommended supplies list with suggested vendors in the course.

faqs.question: What certification do I receive?
faqs.answer: Upon successful completion, you receive an official Brendia Pro® certification that you can display in your salon and use in your marketing materials. This certification demonstrates your commitment to excellence and professional training.

faqs.question: Is the certification recognized internationally?
faqs.answer: Brendia Pro® certifications are recognized globally within the professional hair extension community. Our graduates work successfully across 30+ countries. While beauty licensing varies by location, our certification adds significant credibility to your qualifications.

faqs.question: How do I become certified?
faqs.answer: Certification is earned by completing all course modules and submitting practical assessments of your work. Our team reviews your submissions and provides personalized feedback. Most students achieve certification within their first attempt.

faqs.question: What payment options are available?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards and offer payment plans to make education accessible. Contact us to discuss payment plan options that work for your budget.

faqs.question: Is there a refund policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 14-day satisfaction guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied with your course within the first 14 days, contact us for a full refund. After 14 days, all sales are final, but we're committed to your success and will work with you to address any concerns.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade from Artist to Advanced Artist later?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Many students complete Brendia Pro® Artist first and upgrade to Advanced Artist later. We offer a special upgrade price for existing Artist graduates. Contact us for current upgrade pricing.

faqs.question: How long do I have access to the course?
faqs.answer: You have lifetime access to all course materials. This includes any updates we make to the curriculum over time. Log in anytime to review lessons or access new content.

faqs.question: What if I get stuck or have questions?
faqs.answer: You'll have access to our private community where you can connect with other students and certified professionals. For technical issues, our support team is available via email. Advanced Brendia Pro® Artist students also receive priority support.

faqs.question: Can I access the course on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our course platform is fully responsive and works on any device. Watch lessons on your computer, tablet, or smartphone whenever and wherever it's convenient for you.
